scope: Master plan §7.3: direct dependencies already used by existing statements or derivations, with written source and written target in different registered fields.
constraints: No statements, ideas, captions, visualization functions, source flags or shared runtime/build/gate files changed.
Syllabus dependency lists mirror every changed written item.
An existing long path through unrelated prerequisite subjects does not replace a distinct method used directly here; no purely inherited foundation was copied solely to raise a count.
No browser or OCR work was launched for this metadata-only audit.

collections.shortfall_reason: The remaining written orbital and radiative items mainly depend on other physics collections, which do not cross the registered field boundary. Basic calculus already inherited through those laws was not added.

The remaining dynamical-systems and cable prerequisites are often planned ODE, stochastic-process or circuit results. Generic integration routines and references already supplied by the same membrane/cable derivation were excluded.

Most direct prerequisites are other biology models. The advanced bifurcation, stochastic gene-expression and Fokker-Planck theory is largely planned; shared biology field links and generic plotting/integration methods do not count.

peer_review_revisions.reason: Use Fourier transforms of finite-window integrable signals/covariances, rather than assume a periodic-series fundamental period.
The stable-branch density and median require conditional normalization by P(F<1), separately from variable substitution.
Ledger anchors distinguish the general Gibbs equilibrium condition from the target's ideal-gas quotient; aqueous concentration formulas are not equated to the gas special case.

The branch model draws independent Poisson counts with mean theta*length/2, then independent uniform event times (ch03.js line336). This is a modeling assumption/construction, not a deduction from constant mean rate alone.
